entities.summary: Miguel Matamoros (b. 1895, Santiago de Cuba Province) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Modern era, defined by industrialization, revolution, and global conflict, active in Santiago de Cuba Province and Cuba. Known in the fields of cuba, composers & musicians, americas.
